### Top Jewelry Trends

- **Sculptural Gold:** Hefty gold cuffs, wavy metal collars, and fluid rings add architectural structure to everyday outfits.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qhIyVZDEdP0&t=110)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gmBoB-lOwhs&t=39)
- **Mixed-Metal Stacking:** Pairing yellow gold, white gold, and sterling silver breaks the rules of coordinated sets for an effortless look.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gmBoB-lOwhs&t=39)[[2]](https://www.gabrielny.com/blog/jewelry-trends-2026/)
- **Modern Charms:** Chunky gold charms worn over simple sweaters or dangling from heavy bracelets bring personality back into style.[[1]](https://www.instyle.com/dated-jewlery-trends-swaps-12128289)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gmBoB-lOwhs&t=39)
- **Substantial Chains:** Thick rope, paperclip, and herringbone link chains take center stage instead of delicate accent pieces.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/en-gb/guides/jewelry-trends/)
